steps.message: The patch is clean, compiles successfully, and the tests passed. I can now submit the patch.
The patch was submitted successfully. I will now provide the final summary.

The regex error in `rich/cells.py` was caused by two issues: an incorrect usage of the compiled regex object (calling it as a function instead of using `.match()`) and an inefficient/incorrect definition of the compiled regex itself. I fixed this by converting the regex definition to use a raw string literal and removing the erroneous `.match` call during compilation, and subsequently updated the usage in `set_cell_size` to correctly call `.match(text)`. Targeted tests passed after the fix.
